title: BRSR preparation disclosure index
coverage_note: Question-level preparation index of Sections A/B/C, including essential and optional leadership disclosures. Structured forms and calculations cover selected common metrics; complex schedules must cover all subparts in the linked official format. Collection progress is not a certification of BRSR compliance or independent assessment/assurance.
